lead.headline: Trump, Xi, Putin meet in China: first three-way summit
lead.dek: The US president landed for APEC and the first US-China-Russia trilateral talks, after Xi defended free trade and Putin blasted Western sanctions.
lead.caption: economies at APEC; trilateral talks begin

stories.headline: Kerch Bridge span collapses
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones and missiles brought a road span of the 19 km bridge into the strait.

stories.headline: US and Iran trade strikes
